name: Invoke-opencode-acp
headline: Invoke-opencode-acp - Delegate tasks via ACP
short_description: Invoke-opencode-acp is a Claude Code CLI skill that delegates complex tasks to an OpenCode subagent via ACP protocol, reducing token usage by 50-90%. It benefits operations teams by optimizing costs and improving efficiency in AI-driven workflows. The skill connects to Claude Code CLI and supports JSON-RPC for integration.
author: phonowell

sections.overview:
invoke-opencode-acp is a Claude Code CLI skill that delegates complex tasks to an OpenCode subagent through the ACP protocol, significantly reducing token consumption in your main conversation. Instead of Claude processing every file and iteration, the subagent works independently on objectives like multi-file refactoring, batch operations, and code reviews, returning only a concise summary. This approach saves 50-90% tokens by offloading work to alternative models while keeping your main conversation responsive. The skill is ideal for operations teams managing AI-driven workflows, large codebases, and batch file operations where token optimization directly impacts costs. Installation requires Claude Code CLI, OpenCode, and Node.js, with straightforward command-line integration.
Multi-file code refactoring with type hints or style updates
Batch documentation updates across multiple markdown files
Codebase-wide security reviews and vulnerability audits
Git workflows including commits, pull requests, and branch operations
